available.quote: A nonresident of California may become a real estate broker by conforming to all of the provisions of this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a real estate license by fraud, misrepresentation, deceit, or material misstatement of fact in an application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procured, or attempted to procure, a real estate license or license renewal, for themself or a salesperson, by fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit, or by making a material misstatement of fact in an application for a real estate license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering a plea of guilty or no contest to, or being convicted of, a felony or crime substantially related to real estate licensee duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entered a plea of guilty or no contest to, or been found guilty of, or been convicted of, a felony, or a crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a real estate licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly authorizing or aiding in the publication of a material false statement concerning designation, certification, business opportunity, or land subdivision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly authorized, directed, connived at, or aided in the publication, advertisement, distribution, or circulation of a material false statement or representation concerning their designation or certification of special education, credential, trade organization membership, or business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully disregarding or violating the real estate law or the commissioner's rules and regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully disregarded or violated this part or Chapter 1 (commencing with Section 11000) of Part 2 or the rules and regulations of the commissioner for the administration and enforcement of this part

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully using the term 'realtor' or trade name of a real estate organization of which the licensee is not a member.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully used the term "realtor" or a trade name or insignia of membership in a real estate organization of which the licensee is not a member.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a manner that would have warranted denial of the license application, or having a license denied, revoked, or suspended by another agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acted or conducted themself in a manner that would have warranted the denial of their application for a real estate license, either had a license denied or had a license issued by another agency of this state, another state, or the federal government revoked, surrendered, or suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated negligence or incompetence in performing an act for which a license is required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Demonstrated negligence or incompetence in performing an act for which the officer, director, or person is required to hold a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: As a broker licensee, failing to exercise reasonable supervision over the activities of salespersons.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: As a broker licensee, failed to exercise reasonable supervision over the activities of that licensee's salespersons, or, as the officer designated by a corporate broker licensee, failed to exercise reasonable supervision and control of the activities of the corporation for which a real estate license is required.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using government employment access to non-public records in a manner that violates their confidential nature.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used their employment by a governmental agency in a capacity giving access to records, other than public records, in a manner that violates the confidential nature of the records.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any conduct constituting fraud or dishonest dealing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any other conduct, whether of the same or of a different character than specified in this section, that constitutes fraud or dishonest dealing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any terms, conditions, restrictions, or limitations contained in an order granting a restricted license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any of the terms, conditions, restrictions, and limitations contained in an order granting a restricted license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting or inducing the sale or listing of residential property on grounds of loss of value, increase in crime, or decline of school quality due to entry of persons with protected characteristics.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicited or induced the sale, lease, or listing for sale or lease of residential property on the grounds, wholly or in part, of loss of value, increase in crime, or decline of the quality of the schools due to the present or prospective entry into the neighborhood of a person or persons having a characteristic listed in subdivision (a) or (d) of Section 12955 of the Government Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the Franchise Investment Law or related regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated the Franchise Investment Law (Division 5 (commencing with Section 31000) of Title 4 of the Corporations Code) or regulations of the Commissioner of Financial Protection and Innovation pertaining thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the Corporate Securities Law of 1968 or related regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated the Corporate Securities Law of 1968 (Division 1 (commencing with Section 25000) of Title 4 of the Corporations Code) or the regulations of the Commissioner of Financial Protection and Innovation pertaining thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose to a buyer the nature and extent of the licensee's direct or indirect ownership interest in the real property being purchased.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to disclose to the buyer of real property, in a transaction in which the licensee is an agent for the buyer, the nature and extent of a licensee's direct or indirect ownership interest in that real property.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any substantial misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any substantial misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false promises of a character likely to influence, persuade, or induce.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false promises of a character likely to influence, persuade, or induce.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingling the money or property of others with the licensee's own money or property.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commingling with his or her own money or property the money or other property of others which is received and held by him or her.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Claiming or receiving a fee under an exclusive agreement that does not contain a definite, specified date of final and complete termination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Claiming, demanding, or receiving a fee, compensation, or commission under any exclusive agreement authorizing a licensee to perform any acts set forth in Section 10131 for compensation or commission where the agreement does not contain a definite, specified date of final and complete termination.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Claiming or taking any secret or undisclosed amount of compensation or failing to reveal the full amount of compensation to the buyer or seller.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The claiming or taking by a licensee of any secret or undisclosed amount of compensation, commission, or profit or the failure of a licensee to reveal to the buyer or seller contracting with the licensee the full amount of the licensee's compensation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using an option to purchase in an agreement without disclosing the full amount of profit to the buyer or seller prior to exercising the option.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use by a licensee of any provision, which allows the licensee an option to purchase, in an agreement with a buyer or seller that authorizes the licensee to sell, buy, or exchange real estate or a business opportunity for compensation or commission, except when the licensee, prior to or coincident with election to exercise the option to purchase, reveals in writing to the buyer or seller the full amount of the licensee's profit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge or consent of all parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge or consent of all parties thereto.

bonding_required.quote: each licensee shall provide to the department, and at all times maintain in force, a bond in the amount of ten thousand dollars ($10,000) for each location.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Every licensed real estate broker shall have and maintain a definite place of business in the State of California that serves as the broker's office for the transaction of business.

definition_quote.value: A real estate broker within the meaning of this part is a person who, for a compensation or in expectation of a compensation, regardless of the form or time of payment, does or negotiates to do one or more of the following acts for another or others: (a) Sells or offers to sell, buys or offers to buy, solicits prospective sellers or buyers of, solicits or obtains listings of, or negotiates the purchase, sale, or exchange of real property or a business opportunity. (b) Leases or rents or offers to lease or rent, or places for rent, or solicits listings of places for rent, or solicits for prospective tenants, or negotiates the sale, purchase, or exchanges of leases on real property, or on a business opportunity, or collects rents from real property, or improvements thereon, or from business opportunities. (c) Assists or offers to assist in filing an application for the purchase or lease of, or in locating or entering upon, lands owned by the state or federal government. (d) Solicits borrowers or lenders for or negotiates loans or collects payments or performs services for borrowers or lenders or note owners in connection with loans secured directly or collaterally by liens on real property or on a business opportunity. (e) Sells or offers to sell, buys or offers to buy, or exchanges or offers to exchange a real property sales contract, or a promissory note secured directly or collaterally by a lien on real property or on a business opportunity, and performs services for the holders thereof.
